items.title_zh: 开放ADS1299脑电/脑机接口核心SDK生态
items.title_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI Core SDK Ecosystem
bullets_zh: 开源ADS1299脑电/脑机接口生态，覆盖8-64通道硬件设计。
提供MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包及PC、移动端、Linux集成。

bullets_en: Open-source ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem covering 8-64-channel hardware designs.
Provides MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages plus PC, mobile, Linux integration.
Includes Python/MATLAB/R analysis and BCI workflow/validation resources.
items.brief: 开放ADS1299脑电采集与BCI开发生态，降低非侵入式硬件门槛。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG acquisition and BCI development ecosystem that lowers non-invasive hardware barriers.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

Uses an STM32 microcontroller and ships with a mobile application SDK.
Targets consumer-style EEG experiments without invasive surgery.

bullets_zh: CortexOS IA是一个GitHub项目，结合AI与非侵入式EEG脑机接口来解读脑信号。
它旨在让用户通过思维控制动作，尤其帮助行动不便人群。
该项目于2026-09-24发布，是面向无障碍的开源BCI工具。
bullets_en: CortexOS IA is a GitHub project combining AI and non-invasive EEG-based BCI to interpret brain signals.
It aims to let users control actions by thought, especially for people with reduced mobility.
Published on 2026-09-24 as an open-source accessibility-oriented BCI tool.
items.brief: CortexOS IA是基于AI与EEG的非侵入式BCI项目，帮助行动不便者用思维控制。
items.brief_en: CortexOS IA is an AI/EEG non-invasive BCI project helping people with reduced mobility control actions by thought.
items.raw_excerpt: **CortexOS IA** est une solution basée sur l’**intelligence artificielle et les interfaces cerveau-machine (BCI)** qui analyse les signaux EEG afin de permettre aux utilisateurs de **commander certaines actions par la pensée**, notamment pour faciliter l’autonomie des personnes à mobilité réduite.
